about_short_description.short_description: AI agents for faster, more cost effective employment verifications

product.name: AI-Powered Employment & Income Verifications
product.description: Automates employment and income verifications using AI agents that contact employers via phone, email, or fax to reduce manual work and turnaround times.

product.name: Comprehensive Verification Services
product.description: Provides various verification types including employment, income, reference, DOT, education, court records, and lab/clinic follow-ups.

product.name: Contact Research Capabilities
product.description: Conducts extensive contact research with access to nearly every active employer in the US and 100 million businesses worldwide to support verifications.

product.name: API Integration for Verification Data
product.description: Delivers verification results directly to client systems via API for real-time data access and workflow automation.

product.name: AI Agents for Unrestricted Outreach
product.description: Uses AI agents to perform unlimited simultaneous outbound calls and emails for verifications without limits on attempts.

identifier.value: AI Cost Accounting for Manufacturers & Retailers

product.name: AI Cost Accounting for Manufacturers & Retailers
product.description: Automates bill of materials, standard costing, and variance analysis by connecting ERP, PDFs, and spreadsheets for cost accounting.
